metadata.title: Coloring Monomial Cayley Graphs: The One-Parameter Case
metadata.abstract: How do algebraic relations among unit directions influence the chromatic number of the plane? We introduce monomial Cayley graphs as a framework for investigating this question, beginning with graphs whose allowed unit steps are signed powers of a single complex parameter. Transcendental parameters give bipartite graphs, while for roots of unity we determine both the chromatic and circular chromatic numbers. As a geometric consequence, every graph admitting a unit-distance embedding in the plane in which the angle between any two edge directions is a rational multiple of $\pi$ is three-colorable. For algebraic noninteger parameters, four colors suffice, and three suffice when the primitive integer minimal polynomial has leading coefficient at least three. We conjecture that three colors suffice for every algebraic noninteger direction parameter and that four suffice for every direction parameter.
metadata.comment: 50 pages; ancillary data and verification scripts included

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 单参数 monomial Cayley graph 的着色
analysis.workSummary: 研究步长为复参数有符号幂的 Cayley graph，处理超越参数与单位根的 chromatic 及 circular chromatic number；给非整数代数参数四着色和一类三着色。
analysis.breakthrough: 连接复参数的代数性质与几何图着色。
analysis.limitations: 所有非整数参数三着色及全部参数四着色仍是猜想，不能列为已证明结果。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 AI 辅助起草、TikZ 图、sextic witness 验证代码、既有图的 monomial embedding 构造与检查，并探索 cyclotomic coloring；ChatGPT 6 未能解决两项所列猜想。
